category.name: Form Fields
category.preferred_workflow: Create a fresh Document, use DocumentBuilder's InsertTextInput, InsertCheckBox, and InsertComboBox methods to add fields, retrieve them via Document.Range.FormFields, validate existence and type, modify Result, Checked, or DropDownItems as needed, and finally protect the document with ProtectionType.AllowOnlyFormFields before saving.

strict_api_bans: Never assume that a form field already exists in the target document; always insert or verify it explicitly.
Do not use StructuredDocumentTag or other content-control APIs when the task requires legacy form fields.
Avoid inventing helper methods that are not part of the Aspose.Words API.
canonical_patterns: Use DocumentBuilder.InsertTextInput, InsertCheckBox, and InsertComboBox to create legacy fields.
Access existing fields through Document.Range.FormFields and use Result, Checked, or DropDownItems according to the field type.
Validate that each field was added and that its properties match the expected defaults before saving.
nullable_warning_prevention: Check for null after retrieving a FormField from the collection before dereferencing it.
Guard against missing items in a combo box by ensuring the items array contains at least one element.
Validate numeric arguments such as maxLength, selectedIndex, and size to stay within the method's contract.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation errors such as CS1503 and CS7036 indicate mismatched argument types or missing required parameters.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code supplies arguments in the wrong order, uses wrong data types, or omits required parameters like maxLength for InsertTextInput or selectedIndex for InsertComboBox.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Consult the Aspose.Words documentation and pass arguments exactly as defined: name (string), TextFormFieldType, format (string), default text (string), maxLength (int) for InsertTextInput; name, isChecked (bool), size (int) for InsertCheckBox; name, items (string[]), selectedIndex (int) for InsertComboBox.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Write a small wrapper that calls the overload with named parameters and compile-time checks to ensure all required arguments are provided.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0246 and CS0234 errors show that types like FormField, TextFormFieldType, and ProtectionType cannot be resolved.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The source file lacks the required using directives or references the wrong Aspose.Words sub-namespaces (e.g., Aspose.Words.Building, Aspose.Words.Forms).
common_failure_patterns.fix: Add using Aspose.Words; using Aspose.Words.Fields; and ensure the project references Aspose.Words.dll version 26.10.0.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Include a standard header block with the necessary using statements in every form-field example template.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Mixing legacy fields with content controls
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Examples that import StructuredDocumentTag or other content-control classes fail to compile or behave unexpectedly.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Legacy form fields and content controls are distinct APIs; the task explicitly requires legacy fields.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove all StructuredDocumentTag usage and rely solely on DocumentBuilder legacy insertion methods and the FormFields collection.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Document the distinction in the coding guidelines and enforce a lint rule that flags any usage of StructuredDocumentTag in form-field samples.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime code attempts to read or modify a field that was never inserted, leading to null-reference exceptions.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The sample code starts by loading a document and directly accesses FormFields without first creating them.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Bootstrap a minimal document that inserts the required fields before any read or update logic.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Include a step in the workflow that always creates a fresh document or explicitly checks for field existence and throws a clear error if missing.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: CS0117 errors indicate that ProtectionType.Forms does not exist.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The correct enum value is ProtectionType.AllowOnlyFormFields; using an outdated or misspelled constant causes compilation failure.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace ProtectionType.Forms with ProtectionType.AllowOnlyFormFields when calling Document.Protect.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference the official enum list in the documentation and add a unit test that verifies document protection can be applied without errors.

narrative.overview: The Form Fields category covers the creation, manipulation, and protection of legacy form fields in Word documents using Aspose.Words. Verified examples demonstrate inserting text inputs, check boxes, combo boxes, updating values, and applying form-only protection with robust validation.
narrative.purpose: Provide concise, reliable guidance for an AI coding agent to generate correct C# snippets that create, read, update, and protect Aspose.Words legacy form fields while avoiding common compilation and runtime pitfalls.
validation_priorities: Always verify that the field name exists in Document.Range.FormFields and that its type matches the intended operation before reading or writing any property.
maintenance_notes: Update the example repository whenever Aspose.Words introduces new overloads or deprecates legacy form-field APIs to keep the samples current.
